test_title: SSC GD Constable Previous Year Paper (Held on: 9th December 2021 Shift 3)
subject: general
question: ‘Inflation’ is related to ‘Deflation’ in the same way as ‘Quick’ is related to ‘________’.
solution:
The logic followed here is:

 
• Inflation is antonym of Deflation.

Similarly,

 
• Quick is antonym of Sluggish.

Hence, '**Sluggish**' is the correct answer.
